note: News-relevant detail from the FICCI-EY Media & Entertainment report (2026 edition, calendar-year data). Transcribed from the report's charts/tables. Online-news audience is Comscore (Dec each year) via FICCI-EY; social-media time and print revenue are EY estimates.

online_news_audience.label: Online news audience, India (Comscore, December each year)
online_news_audience.note: Reach of online news platforms fell about 9% in 2025; AI search summaries and the growth of AI apps were cited by industry stakeholders as the key reasons. Some stakeholders put the drop in their own platform reach at over 30%. Online news reached about 29% of India's population.

social_media_hours.label: Quarterly time spent on social media in India
social_media_hours.pointNote: Points are Q1 2022, Q1 2023, Q1 2024, Q1 2025 and Q4 2025 (the report's plotted quarters).

print_circulation_revenue.label: Print circulation revenue, India
print_circulation_revenue.note: Circulation revenue fell about 1% in 2025, the second annual decline in a row. Publishers increasingly see newspapers as a news product for older (35+) readers, with younger audiences shifting to digital.
